---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a bug or unexpected behavior in the PC port
labels: bug
---

Make sure you give a relevant title to this issue. 

Did you check if there was already a bug report for this?

## Bug Description

A clear and concise description of what the bug is. Why do you think this is broken or should be improved.

## Screenshots or videos

Upload an image or a video of the following:
* The expected behavior (N64 console recording or from an accurate emulaotr)
* The PC Port's behavior

## Steps to Reproduce

Tell us how you got there. 

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

If it happens only 10% of the time, please tell us. Make sure you upload a video of the steps needed to reproduce this bug.

## Environment

- Operating System: e.g. Linux, Windows
- Graphics card: e.g. GTX 5050
- CPU: e.g. i9-14900K
- Computer model (e.g. Stream Deck)
